During the first year of operation, it is advisable to take samples of the lubricating oil after about 1000, 2000 and

results.answer:
The R40 value for an insulation resistance of 30 MΩ measured at 20°C with a correction factor of k=0.25 can be calculated using the formula provided in the context:

$$ R_{40} = k \times R $$

Substituting the values:

$$ R_{40} = 0.25 \times 30 \, \text{MΩ} = 7.5 \, \text{MΩ} $$

Therefore, the R40 value is **7.5 MΩ**. This calculation is based on the example provided on page 91 of the ABB Manual for Induction Motors and Generators.
